'''2008 Worlds Day 2 James Booker DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title Zimmerman Note from Zee Germanz. Inventory side wrongly LS.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[James Booker]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
